tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads the full content of a file from the given path.

path.description: Absolute or relative path of the file to read

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Writes content to a file at the given path. Overwrites existing content.

path.description: Absolute or relative path of the file to write

content.description: Text content to write into the file

cmd.description: The full Windows file related shell command to execute as a single string (supports shell features).

returns.description: Returns subprocess result object on success, error string on failure, or null if user denies execution.
